title: Collect in Portal is held until the portal takes part sale deposits
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A test customer exists.
  • The part sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way), with the part "Brake Pads" (Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91); the sale reads Estimate.
  • Know whether this build's Customer Portal takes part sale deposits: the release notes for this build say so, or ask the QA lead.
  • The expected results cover both answers.
custom_steps:
1. Open Add Deposit and, in the Create Deposit dialog, read the state of Collect In Portal and any reason it shows.
  2. Confirm every other Add Deposit / Record Deposit behaviour works (e.g. record a $50.00 deposit with Record Deposit).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If this build does not yet let the Customer Portal take part sale deposits, Collect in Portal stays disabled and shows the portal's reason.
  • If the Customer Portal does take part sale deposits on this build, Collect in Portal is live (the portal deposit cases then apply).
  • Either way, every other deposit behaviour on the part sale works.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N4: “If a release ships without SV-10261, Collect in Portal stays disabled and shows the portal's reason”
  • S8-N4: “S8-R8 and S8-R11 are live when the Customer Portal accepts part sale deposits (SV-10261)”
  • S8-N4: “Every other requirement in this story is live”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
